headline.purpose: Empty-state titles; the largest text in the system (15px/600).

title.purpose: Dialog and window titles (.ft-title, 13.5px/600); panel and row titles sit a half step down at 13px.

body.purpose: Buttons, fields, palette rows, suggestions, hints; 12.5px/500 default, 10.5-12px dense metadata in text-3.

label.purpose: Uppercase section labels (.ft-label, palette and sidebar headers); tertiary color, 0.08em tracking.

mono.purpose: Musical keys, timecodes, keycaps; always tabular numerals.

shadows.name: popover
shadows.purpose: The floating-layer shadow (--ft-shadow-pop): popovers, menus, autocomplete. Porcelain redefines it lighter (0 8px 24px rgba(20,20,30,0.14), 0 2px 6px rgba(20,20,30,0.1)).

shadows.name: overlay-panel
shadows.purpose: Narrow-window sidebar/palette overlays, cast toward the list they cover (mirrored -12px on the right panel), with a line-strong edge.

shadows.name: anchor-ring
shadows.purpose: Inset hairline ring marking the anchor row and filtering palette rows; elevation without drop shadow.

shadows.name: filter-halo
shadows.purpose: Neutral double-ring around a palette tag dot while it filters the list.

motion.name: interaction
motion.purpose: Background, color, and border-color transitions on buttons, fields, rows, and the keycap press echo.

motion.name: progress
motion.purpose: Width transition of the session progress line; passive indicators only.

motion.name: theme-crossfade
motion.purpose: The one authored theme moment: surface crossfade when switching themes (html.theme-switching); skipped under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: The default button in both vocabularies: quiet until touched; hover wash and brightened text.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 28px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 6px; border: none; background: transparent; color: var(--ft-text-2); font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background 80ms ease-out, color 80ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--ft-hover); color: var(--ft-text); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { background: var(--ft-active); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ft-focus); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The raised primary: one surface step up with a strong hairline. Primary means raised, not colored.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 28px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--ft-raised); border: 1px solid var(--ft-line-strong); color: var(--ft-text); font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background 80ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--ft-overlay); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ft-focus); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Field with Keycap
components.description: Hairline field; focus brightens the border, no glow. A keycap shows the shortcut while empty.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 230px; height: 28px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--ft-panel); border: 1px solid var(--ft-line); transition: border-color 80ms ease-out; } .ds-field:hover { border-color: var(--ft-line-strong); } .ds-field:focus-within { border-color: var(--ft-focus); } .ds-field-icon { color: var(--ft-text-3); flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-field input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; background: none; border: none; outline: none; color: var(--ft-text); font-size: 12.5px; font-family: inherit; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: var(--ft-text-3); } .ds-field .ds-kbd { font-family: 'SF Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 10px; line-height: 1; color: var(--ft-text-3); background: var(--ft-raised); border: 1px solid var(--ft-line); border-bottom-width: 2px; border-radius: 4px; padding: 3px 5px; }

components.name: Tag Chip
components.description: Dot + neutral label pill; the dot carries the user's tag color, the chrome stays quiet.
components.html: peak time
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; height: 22px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 11px; border: 1px solid var(--ft-line); background: var(--ft-panel); max-width: 150px; } .ds-chip-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #fe642d; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-chip-name { font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ft-text-2); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--ft-line-strong); } .ds-chip:hover .ds-chip-name { color: var(--ft-text); } .ds-chip-x { border: none; background: none; padding: 0 0 0 1px; margin-right: -5px; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1; color: var(--ft-text-3); cursor: pointer; border-radius: 50%; width: 18px; height: 18px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-chip-x:hover { color: var(--ft-text); background: var(--ft-active); }

components.name: Keycap
components.description: First-class keyboard hint with a physical 2px bottom edge; the bound key's press collapses the edge for a beat.
components.html: S stage X skip ⌘↵ commit
components.css: .ds-kbd-demo { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--ft-text-3); font-family: -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-kbd { font-family: 'SF Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 10px; line-height: 1; color: var(--ft-text-3); background: var(--ft-raised); border: 1px solid var(--ft-line); border-bottom-width: 2px; border-radius: 4px; padding: 3px 5px; transition: transform 80ms ease-out, border-bottom-width 80ms ease-out; } .ds-kbd:active { transform: translateY(1px); border-bottom-width: 1px; }

components.name: Palette Row
components.description: 26px tag row in the right palette: dot, name, keycap hint, tabular count; hover wash, raised+ring when filtering.
components.css: .ds-pal-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 220px; height: 26px; padding: 0 8px; border: none; background: transparent; border-radius: 5px; cursor: pointer; font-family: -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: left; } .ds-pal-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #3e89fa; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-pal-name { flex: 1; min-width: 0; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ft-text-2); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-pal-key { font-family: 'SF Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 10px; line-height: 1; color: var(--ft-text-3); background: var(--ft-raised); border: 1px solid var(--ft-line); border-bottom-width: 2px; border-radius: 4px; padding: 3px 5px; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-pal-count { font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--ft-text-3); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-pal-row:hover { background: var(--ft-hover); } .ds-pal-row:hover .ds-pal-name { color: var(--ft-text); } .ds-pal-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ft-focus); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Track Row

components.html: Voices (Original Mix)Luigi Madonnatechno1288A
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px 0 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ft-line-faint); font-family: -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; overflow: hidden; } .ds-row:hover { background: var(--ft-hover); } .ds-row-title { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ft-text); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; max-width: 42%; } .ds-row-artist { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--ft-text-3); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; min-width: 0; } .ds-row-spacer { flex: 1; } .ds-chip-mini { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; height: 20px; padding: 0 7px; border-radius: 11px; border: 1px solid var(--ft-line); background: var(--ft-panel); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ft-text-2); flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-chip-mini-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #00d58f; } .ds-row-staged { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; color: var(--ft-text-3); flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-row-pending { width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ft-warn); flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-row-meta { width: 34px; text-align: right; font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--ft-text-2); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-row-key { width: 30px; text-align: right; font-family: 'SF Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 600; color: #fe3fea; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; flex-shrink: 0; }

narrative.overview:
FlowTag's visual world is a neutral dark register: ink surfaces, hairline alpha borders, a tight small type ramp, and almost no chrome color. The interface is an instrument panel for a single power user working through thousands of tracks — density, legibility, and keyboard speed outrank expressiveness. The chrome stays quiet so that the color that matters on screen is the user's own data: tag dots and Camelot key hues carry the meaning. Eight selectable themes re-voice the same system by swapping the --ft-* token values — including four "colorful shelf" themes that tint the interaction layer (focus, washes, selection, waveform) with a single hue while the row field stays quiet.

Depth is conveyed by stepping surface lightness (bg → panel → raised → overlay) and hairline rings, not by color or heavy shadow. Real drop shadows exist only on floating layers (popovers, autocomplete, the narrow-window overlay panels). Interaction feedback is an alpha wash and a brightened border. The stack is Vue 3 + Tailwind v4 + shadcn-vue (reka-ui) + Lucide; two component vocabularies coexist deliberately — hand-rolled .ft-btn / .ft-field / chip primitives for the dense instrument surfaces, and shadcn primitives (owned code, retuned to the --ft-* tokens) for dialogs, menus, and inputs.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet neutral chrome; themes re-tint the whole system by token swap, never per-component
Data color (tag dots, musical key hues) is the user's; chrome hue comes only from the active theme's token set
Hairline alpha borders; surface lightness steps carry structure; a ~2%-alpha zebra stripe textures the list
Small, tight system-font type ramp (10.5–15px); tabular numerals for all data
Fast, quiet transitions (80ms ease-out); keycap hints as first-class UI, with a press echo

rules.name: The Data-Only Color Rule
rules.body: Chrome takes hue only from the active theme's token set; data hue belongs to the user. Tag colors appear as dots, Camelot colors as key text, and no component ever hard-codes a chrome hue outside the --ft-* tokens.

rules.name: The Three-Semantic Rule
rules.body: Exactly three semantic colors exist: warn for unfinished business (pending writes, skip, staged-with-no-tags), danger for destructive actions, and playing green for playback and completed work (done ✓, done count, journal bars, stage progress). No fourth semantic, no info blue.

rules.name: The Token-Swap Rule
rules.body: A theme is a value set for the existing --ft-* tokens applied on <html> — never a parallel stylesheet, never per-component overrides. New chrome styles must read tokens so every theme inherits them for free.

rules.name: The Tabular Numerals Rule
rules.body: Every data numeral — counts, BPM, year, added dates, tag counts, timecodes, progress text — is set tabular (.ft-num, .ft-mono, or Tailwind tabular-nums) so columns never shimmy as values change.

rules.name: The One-Line Rule
rules.body: Header and row labels never wrap: white-space: nowrap is inherited across the header bar, squeezed labels shrink or fold into the overflow menu, and truncation is always an ellipsis.

rules.name: The Float-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows mark things that float above the page (menus, autocomplete, overlay panels). In-flow elements express elevation with surface lightness and hairline rings, never with drop shadows.

dos: Do keep all chrome on the --ft-* tokens; the only hard-coded hue on screen is the user's data — tag dots and Camelot key text (The Data-Only Color Rule, The Token-Swap Rule).
Do set every data numeral tabular via .ft-num, .ft-mono, or tabular-nums.
Do express emphasis by raising the surface one step and adding a line-strong ring (anchor row, primary button, filtering palette row).
Do use 80ms ease-out for interaction transitions and reserve longer motion for passive indicators (300ms progress line) and the one authored moment (240ms theme crossfade) — both reduced-motion-safe.
Do keep keycap hints (.ft-kbd) visible in hints, fields, and the sidebar — keyboard-first is a product constraint — and let bound keys echo on their caps.
Do use warn for unfinished business, danger for destruction, and playing green for playback and completed work — nothing else (The Three-Semantic Rule).
Do use native title tooltips on dense repeated rows and the Hint component on singular controls.
Do show long-running work on-surface in the header (progress bar + tabular count), not in toasts.
donts: Don't hard-code a chrome color in a component; a theme must be able to re-voice it by token swap alone. Theme-hued focus rings, washes, and hairlines are legitimate — but only via the tokens.
Don't add drop shadows to in-flow elements; shadows belong to floating layers only (The Float-Only Shadow Rule).
Don't fill chips with the tag's color; the dot carries the hue, the label stays neutral.
Don't add a fourth semantic color, or spend playing green on anything that isn't playback or completed work.
Don't retint user data colors per theme; only Porcelain's contrast compensation (hue-preserving color-mix, dot rings) touches them.
Don't let header or row labels wrap; shrink, truncate with ellipsis, or fold into the ⋯ overflow menu.
Don't restyle the legacy views (AutoTagger, Tag Editor, Renamer) with this system; its scope ends at .flowtag-theme and .ft-footer.
